topic: Role mapping and company-specific access logic
summary_markdown: The discussion focused on the technical requirements for managing user roles and permissions within different companies. The current system allows users to see and edit only roles that are explicitly available or generally accessible. A key requirement is to differentiate between common, company-wide roles and roles specific to individual companies. This distinction is necessary for designing a clean and structured new schema.
decisions: The proposed approach for role management involves combining all user roles with the associated company field.
